purpose: Compare observable-driven planning with direct dense execution on one CPU thread, all CPU threads and a GPU, across width, past device memory, for parameter-shift Jacobians and inside a training loop.
workload_source: benchmarks/qml_workload_support.py generators, unchanged from the QML manifest

placement.wide_backend: Qiskit Aer statevector, GPU, double precision, default fusion
placement.basis: per-task crossover between single-thread Qulacs and Aer GPU measured on this host before freezing

lazyqc_gpu.note: auto plan; tasks of at least wide_from qubits run on Aer GPU

aer_cpu.note: Qiskit Aer CPU statevector with default fusion; the strongest multithreaded CPU engine measured on this host (Qulacs with 20 threads was 4.8 times slower at 24 qubits)

quimb.note: direct tensor-network evaluation with quimb's own light-cone simplification and auto-hq paths; a fresh circuit per run because quimb caches simplified networks on the circuit object

lazyqc_aer_gpu.note: auto plan; every task on Aer GPU

lazyqc_lightning_gpu.note: auto plan; every task on Lightning GPU, one device per task width reused across collections

lazyqc_quimb.note: grouped cone plan; every task contracted by quimb

backend_matrix.purpose: Same-backend comparison: direct execution on each backend against LazyQC with every task on that backend; the Qulacs pair is lazyqc versus qulacs_1t from the single-thread pass

scaling.timing_scope: after workload construction; planner: plan plus collect; direct: state allocation, evolution and every requested expectation from a prebuilt circuit
scaling.validation: every method against one reference per case (LazyQC cones, or Aer GPU when the cone saturates beyond 20 qubits) and the NumPy oracle up to 12 qubits; tolerance 1e-9

extra_cases.note: intermediate cone (w=14 = w*), crossing into GPU placement
intermediate cone (w=18 > w*), where cone fits on GPU while full 48q state does not

memory_wall.validation: quimb local expectations with light-cone simplification and exact MPS (cutoff=0), tolerance 1e-9

jacobian.parameters: every RY occurrence, shifted independently by +-pi/2

lazyqc.note: one plan over base and shifted programs, Qulacs collection, shift-rule assembly

aer_gpu_shift.note: one Aer GPU job with every shifted circuit

jacobian.validation: LazyQC Jacobian against the Lightning GPU adjoint Jacobian; tolerance 1e-9

training.loss: mean over wires of (<Z_q> - y_q)^2 with y_q drawn uniformly from [-0.5, 0.5] by seed 20261024

lazyqc.gradient: shift-rule Jacobian then loss chain rule

lightning_gpu_vjp.gradient: forward pass, then adjoint vector-Jacobian product

training.timing_scope: whole step including program or tape construction for the current parameters
training.validation: loss trajectories agree across methods within 1e-8
